# Quick Agentic Memory

GitHub is the source of truth. The [Fabric Graph Projector](concepts/fabric-graph-projector.md)
creates a disposable projection, and the [Wiki MCP Gateway](concepts/wiki-mcp-gateway.md)
gives the [Microsoft Foundry Agent](concepts/foundry-agent.md) bounded access to it.

The [Wiki Curator](concepts/wiki-curator.md) proposes reviewed changes. The
[No Raw Graph Queries](decisions/no-raw-gql.md) decision defines the query boundary.
